provenance.abstraction_rationale: Abstracts the reported crash in torch.nn.functional.cosine_embedding_loss when called with empty mismatched input shapes. The pattern keeps the API-specific evidence from the issue body, comments, and resolution patch without adding future testing instructions.
unresolved_information: No explicit root-cause statement was mapped in the report; the defect mechanism is inferred from a maintainer comment and the resolution patch.

historical_conditions.statement: The API was called with empty tensors.
`input1` had shape `(0, 0)` and dtype `torch.float16`; `input2` had shape `(0,)` and dtype `torch.int8`; `target` had shape `(0,)` and dtype `torch.float32`.

defect_mechanism.description: The C++ implementation only checked the dimensionality of `input1` and did not enforce that `input2` had the matching dimension, so invalid calls with mismatched empty input tensors were not rejected and later caused a segmentation fault.

observed_failure.description: The process terminated with a segmentation fault (core dumped).

historical_observations.statement: The crash was reproduced on the nightly build.
